'''2016 Worlds Day 2 Hayes Hunter DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Imperial Entanglements Hunter DS.txt |Download]]
* '''Username:''' HAYES
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
